verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json: it returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. That delivers the core of the story. Cloudflare's docs also describe a programmatic API surface of over 2,500 endpoints, consistent with a comprehensive spec. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the spec (its scope, versioning, and whether it covers the Workers endpoints), verification of the spec's contents beyond the key check, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using it.
